items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:23:1
items.html: The Yod-Vavare two Behinot Hitpashtut, and the Heys are two Behinot Histalkut. The first Hitpashtut is the Yod; the second Hitpashtut is the Vav. The first Histalkut is the First Heyand the second Histalkut is the last Hey.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:23:2
items.html: HaVaYaH begins only from Hochma downward. It is known that the Yod means Hochma, Vav means ZA, the First Hey means Bina and the last Heymeans Malchut. Keter, however, is not implied in the four Otiot, except in the tip of the Yod. This is so for the reason that the Rav explains below.
